svg.aria-label: AI works because mathematics does. A cloud of points resolves into a surface seen by two cameras, then into a masked attention matrix, then dissolves again.
svg.text: Pradeep Rajasekar, also Ajish Pradeep. AI Research Engineer, Taipei.
3D vision and geometry. On-device inference. LLM systems that never do the maths.
Fig. 1 420 points, three structures: noise, a surface seen by two cameras, a masked attention matrix.
